map.WebM/Opus 体积小、适合网络传输与即时分享；WAV 是无损未压缩、适合后: WebM/Opus is small and suits network transfer and instant sharing; WAV is lossless and uncompressed, suited to later editing and reprocessing. If the file will go into a DAW for fine tuning, export WAV.
map.WebM/Opus 和 WAV 怎么选？: How do I choose between WebM/Opus and WAV?
map.为什么有时录出来有杂音或爆音？: Why do recordings sometimes contain noise or clipping?
map.会议、采访或课堂现场用浏览器麦克风直接录音，实时看到波形与音量，结束即导出素材。: Record straight from the browser microphone for meetings, interviews or classes, watch the waveform and level live, and export the material when finished.
map.基于浏览器麦克风录音，实时波形与音量可视化，支持暂停/继续，可导出 WebM/O: Records with the browser microphone, visualising the waveform and level live, supports pause and resume, and exports to WebM/Opus or WAV. All recording is processed locally and never uploaded to a server.
map.多为输入增益过高导致削波，或环境回授产生啸叫。可先降低麦克风增益、离声源 15~: Usually the input gain is too high and causes clipping, or the room feeds back and creates howling. First lower the microphone gain, stay 15-30 cm from the source, and record in a quiet environment; browser-local processing never uploads audio, so privacy stays under your control.
map.录制配音或播客干声，先试录几秒确认增益合适、无爆音与底噪后再正式录制。: When recording a voiceover or podcast dry track, test-record a few seconds first to confirm the gain is right and there is no clipping or noise floor, then record properly.
map.采集环境声或乐器素材，导出 WAV 保留原始精度用于后期剪辑。: Capture ambience or instrument material and export WAV to keep the original precision for later editing.
map.：在浏览器中用 MediaRecorder 录音，常见约束为采样率 44100H: : in the browser, MediaRecorder is used for recording, with common constraints of 44100 Hz or 48000 Hz sample rate and mono or stereo. For a WebM/Opus container a bit rate around 128 kbps is enough for speech; for lossless material export WAV (16 bit / 44.1 kHz mono is about 5 MB per minute). Before recording, check with the live level meter that the peak stays below 0 dBFS to avoid clipping.
